selected_evidence.requirement: node2 and node3 given addresses on the private network with route via node1

selected_evidence.requirement: processes on node2/node3 can actually reach the internet through node1
selected_evidence.summary: curl bound to private interface succeeds from both nodes; node1 conntrack shows masqueraded flows (src 10.50.50.11/.12 -> translated to 10.100.232.10) reaching internet destinations

selected_evidence.requirement: node1 restart: healthy baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered NAT state
